Name: Junia
Summary: Junia was a kinswoman of Paul and a fellowprisoner, described as of note among the apostles and in Christ before Paul himself.
KeyStory: Junia was a kinswoman of Paul and a fellowprisoner, described as of note among the apostles and in Christ before Paul himself.
LifeLesson: Suffering for Christ alongside others, even in prison, is a mark of honour in the gospel.
